health.title: Health
health.subtitle: Where the rot is — click a number to see the tracks and fix them in place.
health.proDescription: See exactly which tracks are missing files, key, BPM or are duplicated — and fix them in place.

score.head: How this score is calculated

lifecycle.untestedTip: Never played live — added more than 30 days ago
lifecycle.archiveTip: Last played more than 3 years ago, or you archived it
